words.text: Beneath the school lies the Chamber of Secrets.
Its door opens only to Parseltongue.
Three came looking for the monster.
The Basilisk wakes.
Its stare turns the living to stone.
But the stare is slow. The grey closes in.
Look away, and it drains from your sight.
Hold its eyes too long, and you are stone.
Fight it from the edge of your sight.
It rears before it strikes. Get back.
At range, it spits venom. Keep moving.
Too far, and it goes under...
...and comes up beneath you.
Strike the head, from the front.
Enough blows put its eyes out for good.
Blind, it hunts by sound.
Creep, and it cannot hear you.
A Mandrake Restorative Draught...
...brings the stone back to life.
Look away. Strike the head. Move softly.
